title: CHINESE RICE
instructions: Take equal parts of rice and cold water. Wash your rice in several waters, put it in a saucepan, salt, and let it boil. When cooked put aside to soak until dry. Be careful, it burns easily. Every grain of rice will be separate and dry.  "Mon Repos," Aiken, S.C. --MISS EUSTIS.
